messages.snippet: Hi James — are we still on for dinner with the trainees on Thursday at the Italian on Cornhill, 7.30
messages.subject: Dinner Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi James — are we still on for dinner with the trainees on Thursday at the Italian on Cornhill, 7.30? Let me know numbers. (Apologies if this is the wrong James — I have two in my contacts!)

Rebecca
